basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old from Birmingham, UK, diving into the world of Reddit to expand my gaming collection knowledge. I work as a graphic designer during the day and spend my evenings gaming or exploring new trends in wrestling. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends either at local wrestling events or curled up with a good book. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a keen interest in gaming, particularly in Team Fortress 2, which started back in my college days when I first played the game. My knowledge of festive items comes from years of casually collecting and trading in-game items. Additionally, I'm a self-taught graphic designer with a passion for digital art.
